scope: story-045/046 relinquishPrincipal accounting on hoisted AYieldStrategy base
rateModel: AMM buy/sell rate PEGGED to live vault convertToShares/convertToAssets every action (no decoupled setSellRate; avoids run-11/run-12 false positives)
excludedDeliberately: realizableSolvency / realizable>=principal — over-strict, known false alarm, collapses into acknowledged M-02/QA-08

invariants.name: invariant_principalSum
invariants.description: totalDeposited[token] == Σ clientBalances[token][client] after any interleaving of deposit/withdraw/relinquishPrincipal/skimSurplus/depositAsOwner/withdrawAsOwner across 3 clients

invariants.name: invariant_valueConservation
invariants.description: Total underlying paid OUT to clients/recipient/owner never exceeds total paid IN plus realized vault yield

invariants.name: invariant_orphanDoesNotBreakConservation
invariants.description: When totalDeposited==0 while getTotalShares()>0 (orphaned value), the orphan must never enable value creation

invariants.name: invariant_relinquishLoosensSolvency
invariants.description: relinquishPrincipal only ever increases or holds the solvency margin (_positionValue() - totalDeposited); never decreases it
